mod.name: TB Library (global configs)
mod.summary: TBLib holds the settings shared by all TB mods: who is an admin, which money is used, premium status, key binds, vehicle sizes, logging and NPC outfits. Change them once here and every TB mod follows.
mod.notes: The Premium page describes the AddPremium folder (files named SteamID_Days_ModName.premium, 1-999 days) and premium coins; those are not JSON configs. ReputationSystem is a scripting API, not a config. Tip4ServApiConfig and TBKeyCodeMatch have no version fields.

files.title: Admin rights (all TB mods)
files.summary: Lists which players are admins in which TB mods. One entry per player id; the entry named "Add here Steam Or DayZ ID" is a template you can copy.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

admins.label: Admins
admins.help: One entry per admin. The key is the player's Steam 64 id or DayZ id; the entry lists in which mods that person is an admin.

admins.*.label: Admin entry
admins.*.help: Rights of one admin. The key is the Steam 64 id or DayZ id of that player. The entry named "Add here Steam Or DayZ ID" is only a template.

admins.*.dailyRewardAdmin.label: Daily Reward admin
admins.*.dailyRewardAdmin.help: 1 gives this player admin rights inside Daily Reward (admin menu and admin actions); 0 keeps normal player rights. Only grant it to people you trust.
admins.*.dailyRewardAdmin.risk: Admin rights let the person change or give out things in that mod.

files.title: Currencies
files.summary: Defines the money the TB mods use: which items count as money and what they are worth, and whether a bank mod is used.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

currencyValues.label: Old currency values (deprecated)
currencyValues.help: Old top-level money table kept for compatibility. The docs mark it as deprecated and going away; use the values inside "currencies" instead.

useMoneyFromLBMasterATM.label: Use LBMaster ATM (deprecated)
useMoneyFromLBMasterATM.help: Old top-level switch for the LBMaster ATM bank link, deprecated in favour of the per-currency setting. Leave at 0.

currencies.label: Currencies
currencies.help: The list of currencies the TB mods can use for prices. One entry must have the unique name "default".

currencies[].uniqueName.label: Unique name
currencies[].uniqueName.help: Internal name other TB configs use to refer to this currency. Must be unique, and one currency has to be called "default" or things break.
currencies[].uniqueName.risk: Renaming or removing "default" can break prices in the other TB mods.

currencies[].displayName.label: Display name
currencies[].displayName.help: Name players see in game for this currency (for example Ruble).

currencies[].currencyValues.label: Money items
currencies[].currencyValues.help: Table of money item class names and what each is worth in this currency.

currencies[].currencyValues.*.label: Item value
currencies[].currencyValues.*.help: Worth of one money item (the key is its class name, case-sensitive), for example 50 for a 50 banknote. Expansion banknote types are supported too.

currencies[].useLBMasterATM.label: Use LBMaster ATM
currencies[].useLBMasterATM.help: 1 pays and charges through the LBMaster ATM bank balance instead of money items; 0 uses items only. Needs the LBMaster ATM mod loaded.

currencies[].useDCBanking.label: Use DC Banking
currencies[].useDCBanking.help: 1 pays and charges through the DC Banking system instead of money items; 0 uses items only. Needs that banking mod loaded.

files.title: Global logging
files.summary: Controls CSV and Discord logging of premium coin use and premium file grants, and daily log rotation for all TB mods.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

logUsePremiumCoinCSV.label: Log premium coin use to CSV
logUsePremiumCoinCSV.help: 1 writes a CSV line whenever a player activates a premium coin; files go under the TBMods Logs/Global folder, one place per player.

logUsePremiumCoinDiscord.label: Log premium coin use to Discord
logUsePremiumCoinDiscord.help: 1 posts premium coin activations to Discord. Needs the webhook below.

discordUsePremiumCoinWebhookURL.label: Premium coin webhook
discordUsePremiumCoinWebhookURL.help: Address of the Discord webhook that receives premium coin activations. Leave empty to send nothing. Treat it like a password: anyone who has it can post to your channel.

logUsePremiumAPICSV.label: Log premium API grants to CSV
logUsePremiumAPICSV.help: 1 writes a CSV line when a premium file from the AddPremium folder is processed.

logPremiumAPIDiscord.label: Log premium API grants to Discord
logPremiumAPIDiscord.help: 1 posts processed premium grants to Discord. Needs the webhook below.

discordLogPremiumAPIWebhookURL.label: Premium API webhook
discordLogPremiumAPIWebhookURL.help: Address of the Discord webhook that receives premium grants from the AddPremium folder. Leave empty to send nothing. Treat it like a password: anyone who has it can post to your channel.

enableGlobalLogFileRotation.label: Rotate log files by date
enableGlobalLogFileRotation.help: 1 starts a new CSV log file per day for all TB mods; 0 keeps appending to one file, which can grow large.

files.title: Premium file API
files.summary: Switch and timing for handing out premium status through files in the AddPremium folder.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

enableAPI.label: Enable premium file API
enableAPI.help: 1 lets you hand out premium status by dropping files named SteamID_Days_ModName.premium into the AddPremium folder; the mod checks the folder regularly. 0 disables it.

checkAPITimeInMinutes.label: Check interval
checkAPITimeInMinutes.help: How often (in minutes) the AddPremium folder is checked. The lowest allowed value is 1.

files.title: Key binds
files.summary: Default keys for the TB mod menus and whether the server forces them on players.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

keyBinds.label: Key binds
keyBinds.help: List of key bindings the TB mods offer to players (open daily reward, open war party, and so on).

keyBinds[].name.label: Action name
keyBinds[].name.help: Name of the input action (for example UAInputOpenTBDailyReward). Defined by the mods; do not rename.

keyBinds[].defaultKey.label: Default key code
keyBinds[].defaultKey.help: Number of the key used for this action. Look the number up in TBKeyCodeMatch.json (for example 25 is P).

keyBinds[].useServerKeyBind.label: Force server key
keyBinds[].useServerKeyBind.help: 1 makes every player use the key above even if they chose their own. 0 lets saved player choices stay; players keep their own saved key until you set 1 or they reset it.

files.title: Key code lookup table
files.summary: Reference table that maps key code numbers to key names. Use it to find the number for TBKeyBindsConfig. It is meant to be read, not edited.

keyCodes.label: Key codes
keyCodes.help: Lookup table from key code number to key name.

keyCodes.*.label: Key name
keyCodes.*.help: Name of the key whose code is this entry's key. Reference data; do not change.
keyCodes.*.risk: Editing this table does not change keys in game and may confuse other configs.

files.title: Tip4Serv integration
files.summary: Connects the server to Tip4Serv so purchases can grant premium. Contains a secret token.

enableAPI.label: Enable Tip4Serv
enableAPI.help: 1 makes the server ask Tip4Serv now and then whether players bought something, so the purchase can grant premium in the TB mods. 0 disables it. Needs TBLib 5.32.0 or newer.

apiToken.label: Tip4Serv token
apiToken.help: Bearer token from your Tip4Serv account, used to authenticate the server. Keep it private.
apiToken.risk: Anyone with this token can act as your Tip4Serv server account. Never share the file.

checkAPITimeInMinutes.label: Check interval
checkAPITimeInMinutes.help: How often (in minutes) the server asks Tip4Serv for new purchases.

files.title: Vehicle spawn sizes
files.summary: Space needed per vehicle type, used by Car Dealer, Second Hand Market and Daily Reward when placing a vehicle.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

vehicleSizes.label: Vehicle sizes
vehicleSizes.help: Space each vehicle needs when spawned by Car Dealer, Second Hand Market and Daily Reward, so the spawn spot is checked for room. One entry per vehicle class plus "default".

vehicleSizes.*.label: Size (3 numbers)
vehicleSizes.*.help: Three numbers: width, height and length of the space the vehicle needs. The key is the vehicle class name, or "default" for vehicles not listed.

vehicleSizes.*[].label: Dimension
vehicleSizes.*[].help: One of the three dimensions. Order is width, height, length.

files.title: NPC gear sets
files.summary: One file per NPC outfit, used by mods that spawn trader NPCs (for example Death Insurance). The mod creates a missing file when a config names a new set.

name.label: Gear set name
name.help: Name of this NPC outfit. It must match the file name without .json; other configs refer to it by this name.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

items.label: Items
items.help: Everything the NPC wears or carries.

items[].quantityInPercent.label: Condition / fill
items[].quantityInPercent.help: How full or healthy the item is, 100 meaning perfect or full.

items[].attachments.label: Attachments
items[].attachments.help: Items attached to or inside this item. Same structure as an item; empty list if none.

items[].attachments[].type.label: Attachment class
items[].attachments[].type.help: Class name of the attached item.

items[].attachments[].quantityInPercent.label: Attachment condition
items[].attachments[].quantityInPercent.help: Condition or fill level of the attached item.

items[].attachments[].slot.label: Attachment slot
items[].attachments[].slot.help: Attachments use an empty text here instead of a body slot name.
